note: Menu Block Title adds one checkbox ('Block title as menu link parent') to menu-based blocks, stored as a third-party setting on the block config entity: block.block.<id> -> third_party_settings.menu_block_title.modify_title: true. It has no configure route, no permissions, no services and no Drush. hook_block_view_alter registers a pre_render that relabels the block title to a link to the active menu item's parent. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real block config entities (system_menu_block:* derivatives) created/inspected on the live site; all local.

evals.prompt: The menu_block_title module has no settings page. How do I turn on its 'Block title as menu link parent' behaviour for a menu block, and where is that choice stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. You tick 'Block title as menu link parent' on the block's config form; it is stored as a third-party setting on the block config entity: block.block.<id> -> third_party_settings.menu_block_title.modify_title: true.

evals.prompt: On which blocks does the menu_block_title checkbox appear, and what does the module do at render time when it is enabled?
evals.expected_output: The checkbox appears only on menu-based blocks (those whose form has settings[menu_levels]) - core system_menu_block:* derivatives and the contrib menu_block module. When enabled, hook_block_view_alter adds a pre_render that replaces the block title with a link to the active menu item's parent, plus a route.menu_active_trails cache context.

evals.prompt: A site builder enabled 'Block title as menu link parent' on a menu block using menu_block_title but nothing changes. What two conditions must hold for the modified title to show, and what does the title become?
evals.expected_output: The block must be a menu block and its title must be displayed (label_display visible, not hidden). When both hold, the title becomes a link render array pointing to the active trail item's parent.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one menu block has the menu_block_title 'Block title as menu link parent' option enabled. Inspect the live block configuration and give the machine name (block id) of that block.
evals.expected_output: The block is mbt_known: block.block.mbt_known has third_party_settings.menu_block_title.modify_title: true.

evals.prompt: This site has two menu blocks, mbt_on and mbt_off, both created by the menu_block_title workflow. Exactly one has 'Block title as menu link parent' enabled. Inspect the live configuration and state which block has it enabled.
evals.expected_output: mbt_on has it enabled (third_party_settings.menu_block_title.modify_title: true); mbt_off does not.

evals.prompt: This site has a menu block with the config id mbt_task (a system_menu_block:main block). Using the menu_block_title module, enable the 'Block title as menu link parent' option on it and apply the change to the live site.

On my Drupal site I want a sidebar navigation block for the Main navigation menu, starting at the second level, whose heading links back to the current section's parent page (using the menu_block_title module). Create a menu block with the id mbt_built for the main menu, showing its title, and enable that parent-title behaviour. Save it on the site.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity block.block.mbt_built exists with a menu plugin (system_menu_block:main or a menu_block derivative), label_display visible, and third_party_settings.menu_block_title.modify_title === true.
